Riva: Smart Reception

Never lose another job to a missed call.

This one is a private build for now. Ask me for a walkthrough.How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

Answer every call for a small business, in English or French, book the appointment, draft the quote for one tap approval and follow up by text.

II

The problem

Answering services are expensive and generic, and voicemail is where jobs go to die.

III

What I built

An editorial website that explains how a call is handled, with an interactive voice demo, industry pages, pricing, a FAQ and a booking door. A specialist deploys and manages the receptionist so no technical skill is needed.

IV

How it works

Calls are answered by a conversational voice agent, transcribed and summarised. Each conversation creates the contact, drafts the quote and queues the follow up. The owner approves with one tap.

V

Craft

Water and ink: a calm sea as the backdrop, a crossed keys mark, a serif with a hotel's manners.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

Riva: Smart Reception
VII

In short

  • Answers around the clock in two languages
  • Books, quotes, follows up
  • Owner approves with one tap
  • Keeps the existing number
